title: fix: wire useSafeFieldLabel and type-aware cell renderers into detail page components
body:
Detail page field labels, related list column headers, and highlight fields were rendering raw `field.label || field.name` without passing through the convention-based i18n resolver (`{ns}.fields.{objectName}.{fieldName}`). Related list auto-generated columns also lacked type-aware cell renderers, causing dates to show raw ISO strings, lookups to show raw IDs, and selects to render without badges. Additionally, 11 `detail.*` translation keys used by `useDetailTranslation` defaults were missing from the `en.ts` and `zh.ts` locale packs. ### Field label i18n - Thread `objectName` from `DetailView` → `SectionGroup` → `DetailSection` / `HeaderHighlight` / `RelatedList` - Call `useSafeFieldLabel().fieldLabel(objectName, field.name, fallback)` in each component, consistent with the pattern already used in `ObjectGrid`, `ObjectForm`, and `ListView` ```tsx // Before
{field.label || field.name}
// After const { fieldLabel } = useSafeFieldLabel();
{fieldLabel(objectName || '', field.name, field.label || field.name)}
``` ### RelatedList type-aware cell rendering - Auto-generated columns from `objectSchema.fields` now use `getCellRenderer` to produce a `cell` function for each column, so dates, currencies, selects/badges, lookups, booleans, and other typed fields render properly instead of showing raw values - Null/undefined values in related list cells render as a styled em-dash (`—`), consistent with `DetailSection` ### RelatedList bug fix - Sortable column header buttons were iterating over raw `columns` prop instead of `effectiveColumns`, so auto-generated columns from `objectSchema.fields` never appeared in the sort UI ### Console fallback section title i18n - `RecordDetailView` fallback section title changed from hardcoded `'Details'` to `t('detail.details')` via `useObjectTranslation` ### Missing locale keys - Added `activity`, `editRow`, `deleteRow`, `deleteRowConfirmation`, `actions`, `previousPage`, `nextPage`, `pageOf`, `sortBy`, `filterPlaceholder`, `highlightFields` to both `en.ts` and `zh.ts` — these were already in `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` but absent from the locale packs
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 修复详情页与相关表字段的国际化显示和字段类型支持 > ### 问题清单（见 objectstack-ai/objectui#968 objectstack-ai/objectui#883 objectstack-ai/objectui#942） > > 1. **详情页字段名未做国际化** > - Details Tab、相关子表等记录字段名��示无多语言切换，未统一调用 useObjectLabel / fieldLabel。 > 2. **相关表（子表）字段未做国际化** > - Related Tab 的表头、字段、按钮未统一支持 i18n，尤其字段名、title/section 名、操作按钮。 > 3. **相关表/字段类型显示不统一** > - 相关表 reference/lookup 字段只显示 ID，无关联对象展示（如订单显示 o1、o2）；类型/格式未区分 badge、链接、日期等显示方式。 > 4. **详情页 Tab、分组标题未国际化** > - Tab（详情/相关/活动）、 SectionGroup/分组、区块 title 均需支持 i18n。 > 5. **空值与日期显示未国际化处理** > - 空值统一显示（如淡化样式）；日期字段按用户 locale 格式化。 > 6. **相关表支持 View All、Inline Edit/Delete、新建等操作** > - 支持子表批量操作、Tab布局、分页排序，按钮名需多语言。 > 7. **详情页高亮区、字段类型显示未达 Salesforce 动态相关列表模式** > - 支持动态高亮区、分组/可收起、相关表按模型自动生成。 > > --- > #### 参考资料 > - Salesforce 相关表设计：https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.customizing_related_lists.htm > - Dynamic Related List 实践：https://www.salesforceben.com/ultimate-guide-to-salesforce-dynamic-related-lists/ > > > > > > 任务完成后：请运行全部相关测试，用 ROADMAP.md 记录进展，更新相关 issues。如果改动涉及 ObjectStack 其他仓库，请创建 cross-repo 任务。 > > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
